arxiv-2012-10744.title: GlocalNet: Class-aware Long-term Human Motion Synthesis
arxiv-2012-10744.creator: Neeraj Battan, Yudhik Agrawal, Sai Soorya Rao, Aman Goel, Avinash Sharma
arxiv-2012-10744.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Neeraj Battan, Yudhik Agrawal, Sai Soorya Rao, Aman Goel, Avinash Sharma. Synthesis of long-term human motion skeleton sequences is essential to aid human-centric video generation [ 8 ] with potential applications in Augmented Reality, 3D character animations, pedestrian trajectory prediction, etc.

arxiv-2202-02210.title: Simulating and visualizing COVID-19 contact tracing with Corona-Warn-App for increased understanding of its privacy-preserving design
arxiv-2202-02210.creator: Nikolas Gritsch, Benjamin Tegeler, and Faheem Hassan Zunjani
arxiv-2202-02210.description: Abstract The world is under an ongoing pandemic, COVID-19, of a scale last seen a century ago. Contact tracing is one of the most critical and highly effective tools for containing and breaking the chain of infections especially in the case of infectious respiratory diseases like COVID-19.

arxiv-2203-15170.title: High-Dimensional Vector Autoregression with Common Response and Predictor Factors
arxiv-2203-15170.creator: Di Wang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Guodong Li, Ruey S. Tsay, School of Mathematical Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
arxiv-2203-15170.description: Abstract The reduced-rank vector autoregressive (VAR) model can be interpreted as a supervised factor model, where two factor modelings are simultaneously applied to response and predictor spaces. This article introduces a new model, called vector autoregression with common response and predictor factors, to explore further the common structure between the response and predictors in the VAR framework.

arxiv-2206-02737.title: Investigating the use of Paraphrase Generation for Question Reformulation in the FRANK QA System
arxiv-2206-02737.creator: Nick Ferguson, Liane Guillou, Kwabena Nuamah, Alan Bundy
arxiv-2206-02737.description: Abstract We present a study into the ability of paraphrase generation methods to increase the variety of natural language questions that the FRANK Question Answering system can answer. We first evaluate paraphrase generation methods on the LC-QuAD 2.0 dataset using both automatic metrics and human judgement, and discuss their correlation.

arxiv-2306-00886.title: Bounds on BDD-Based Bucket Elimination
arxiv-2306-00886.creator: Stefan Mengel
arxiv-2306-00886.description: Abstract We study BDD-based bucket elimination, an approach to satisfiability testing using variable elimination which has seen several practical implementations in the past. We prove that it allows solving the standard pigeonhole principle formulas efficiently, when allowing different orders for variable elimination and BDD-representations, a variant of bucket elimination that was recently introduced.

arxiv-2407-21030.title: Cluster and Separate: a GNN Approach to Voice and Staff Prediction for Score Engraving
arxiv-2407-21030.description: Abstract This paper approaches the problem of separating the notes from a quantised symbolic music piece (e.g., a MIDI file) into multiple voices and staves. This is a fundamental part of the larger task of music score engraving (or score typesetting), which aims to produce readable musical scores for human performers.

arxiv-2410-01775.title: Optimization of a Quantum Subset Sum Oracle
arxiv-2410-01775.creator: Angelo Benoit, Sam Schwartz, and Ron K. Cytron
arxiv-2410-01775.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Angelo Benoit, Sam Schwartz, and Ron K. Cytron. We investigate the implementation of an oracle for the Subset Sum problem for quantum search using Grover’s algorithm. Our work concerns reducing the number of qubits, gates, and multi-controlled gates required by the oracle. We describe the compilation of a Subset Sum instance into a quantum oracle, using a Python library we developed for Qiskit and have published in GitHub.

arxiv-2501-08379.title: Fermion liquids as quantum Hall liquids in phase space: A unified approach for anomalies and responses
arxiv-2501-08379.creator: Jaychandran Padayasi, Ken K. W. Ma, Kun Yang
arxiv-2501-08379.description: Abstract The discovery of many strongly correlated metallic phases has inspired different routes to generalize or go beyond the celebrated Landau Fermi liquid theory. To this end, from universal consideration of symmetries and anomalies, Else, Thorngren and Senthil (ETS) have introduced a class of theories called ersatz Fermi liquids which possess a Fermi surface and satisfy a generalized Luttinger’s theorem.

arxiv-2502-16339.title: Dynamic Coalition Structure Detection in Natural Language-based Interactions Conference: Proc. of the 24th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2025); May 19 – 23, 2025; Detroit, Michigan, USA <<submission id>> Thanks: * Equal contribution.
arxiv-2502-16339.creator: Abhishek N. Kulkarni*, Andy Liu*, Jean-Raphaël Gaglione, Daniel Fried, Ufuk Topcu
arxiv-2502-16339.description: Abstract . In strategic multi-agent sequential interactions, detecting dynamic coalition structures is crucial for understanding how self-interested agents coordinate to influence outcomes. However, natural-language-based interactions introduce unique challenges to coalition detection due to ambiguity over intents and difficulty in modeling players’ subjective perspectives.

plos-pone-0008128.creator: Laura De Marco, Anna Gillio-Tos, Valentina Fiano et al.
plos-pone-0008128.description: PLOS ONE research article. Occult Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection is a new pathological entity characterized by presence of liver disease and absence or very low levels of detectable HCV-RNA in serum. Abnormal values of liver enzymes and presence of replicative HCV-RNA in peripheral blood mononuclear cel

pmc-10537709.title: Insecticidal Activity of Tannins from Selected Brown Macroalgae against the Cotton Leafhopper Amrasca devastans
pmc-10537709.creator: Ganeshan Petchidurai, Kitherian Sahayaraj, Laila A. Al-Shuraym, Bader Z. Albogami, Samy M. Sayed
pmc-10537709.description: Seaweeds, also known as marine macroalgae, are renewable biological resources that are found worldwide and possess a wide variety of secondary metabolites, including tannins. Drifted brown seaweed (DBSW) is particularly rich in tannins and is regarded as biological trash. The cotton leaf hopper Amrasca devastans (Distant) has caused both quantitative and qualitative losses in cotton production.

pmc-10575105.title: Dual-Mode Conical Horn Antenna with 2-D Azimuthal Monopulse Pattern for Millimeter-Wave Applications †
pmc-10575105.creator: Asrin Piroutiniya, Mohamad Hosein Rasekhmanesh, José Luis Masa-Campos, José Luis Calero-Rodríguez, Jorge A Ruiz-Cruz, Shah Nawaz Burokur
pmc-10575105.description: In this paper, a novel concept of a three-dimensional full metal system including a Dual-Mode Converter (DMC) network integrated with a high-gain Conical Horn Antenna (CHA) is presented. This system is designed for 5G millimeter wave applications requiring monopulse operation at K-band (37.5–39 GHz). The DMC integrates two mode converters.

pmc-10647422.title: Alterations to Kidney Physiology during Cardiopulmonary Bypass—A Narrative Review of the Literature and Practical Remarks
pmc-10647422.creator: Jakub Udzik, Jerzy Pacholewicz, Andrzej Biskupski, Paweł Walerowicz, Kornelia Januszkiewicz, Ewa Kwiatkowska, Bernhard Rauch
pmc-10647422.description: Introduction: According to different authors, cardiac surgery-associated acute kidney injury (CSA-AKI) incidence can be as high as 20–50%. This complication increases postoperative morbidity and mortality and impairs long-term kidney function in some patients. This review aims to summarize current knowledge regarding alterations to renal physiology during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) and to discuss possible nephroprotective strategies for cardiac surgeries.

pmc-10747843.title: Investigation on Electrospun and Solvent-Casted PCL-PLGA Blends Scaffolds Embedded with Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells for Tissue Engineering
pmc-10747843.creator: Mariella Rosalia, Martina Giacomini, Erika Maria Tottoli, Rossella Dorati, Giovanna Bruni, Ida Genta, Enrica Chiesa, Silvia Pisani, Maurilio Sampaolesi, Bice Conti
pmc-10747843.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The design, production, and characterisation of tissue-engineered scaffolds made of polylactic-co-glycolic acid (PLGA), polycaprolactone (PCL) and their blends obtained through electrospinning (ES) or solvent casting/particulate leaching (SC) manufacturing techniques are presented here. The polymer blend composition was chosen to always obtain a prevalence of one of the two polymers, in order to investigate the contribution of the less concentrated polymer on the scaffolds’ properties.

pmc-11494766.title: The association of fructose and fiber consumption and physical activity with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in children and adolescents: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11494766.creator: Camellia Akhgarjand, Mahdieh Entezarian, Simin Samavat, Aryan Tavakoli, Aliarash Anoushirvani, Golaleh Asghari, Emad Yusbashian, Pooneh Dehghan, Parvin mirmiran, Hossein Imani
pmc-11494766.description: BackgroundNon-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is emerging as the most prevalent liver disease in overweight and obese children. While no cure exists, dietary and lifestyle modifications have been shown to improve the condition. This study investigates the relationship between fructose and fiber consumption, physical activity, and NAFLD in children.

pmc-11696667.title: Intrathecal pemetrexed improves survival outcomes in previously treated EGFR-mutant advanced non-small-cell lung cancer with leptomeningeal metastases
pmc-11696667.creator: Liqun Li, Zhe Huang, Yangqian Chen, Hongzhi Ma, Xiaoquan Chen, Huan Yan, Haoyue Qin, Yuda Zhang, Xing Zhang, Wenjuan Jiang, Zhan Wang, Lin Zhang, Fanxu Zeng, Zhiguo Zhou, Xingxiang Pu, Nong Yang, Liang Zeng, Yongchang Zhang
pmc-11696667.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveThis study assessed the impact of intrathecal pemetrexed (IP) in managing leptomeningeal metastases (LM) in previously treated patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).MethodsWe analyzed the clinical and survival outcomes of 50 patients with LM who received 50 mg IP after disease progression with epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) treatment between September 2021 and September 2023 at the Hunan Cancer Hospital. Treatment response was evaluated based on improvement in neurological symptoms/signs and Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS) scores.

pmc-12469453.title: A Thirty-Year Forensic Case Report of Chronic Psychosis: Systemic Implications for Italian Forensic Psychiatry
pmc-12469453.creator: Luigi Buongiorno, Anna Margari, Gabriele Mandarelli, Roberto Catanesi, Anna Cassano, Francesco Carrieri, Lia Parente, Felice Carabellese
pmc-12469453.description: Background: Italy’s forensic psychiatric system has undergone major reforms over recent decades, shifting from custodial institutions to a right-based, community-oriented model. While internationally praised for its commitment to dignity, recovery, and social reintegration, this framework presupposes a degree of clinical recoverability that is not always achievable.

pmc-12692710.title: Retinal Organoid-Derived Exosomes Reduce CNV Lesion and Restore RPE Integrity in Mouse Laser-Induced Choroidal Neovascularization (CNV) Model
pmc-12692710.creator: Jin Young Yang, Yeji Kim, Sumin An, Jung Woo Han, Jun-Sub Choi, Tae Kwann Park
pmc-12692710.description: To address the shortcomings of existing anti-VEGF monotherapy in neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD), we investigated the therapeutic capabilities of exosomes obtained from human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived retinal organoids in a mouse model of laser-induced choroidal neovascularization (CNV). To evaluate Retinal Organoid-derived exosome (RO-Exo) distribution after intravitreal (IVT) injection, calcein-labeled RO-Exo was observed using confocal microscopy.

pmc-12989452.title: Guest Edited Collection: “Ecohydraulics” in river and coastal restoration
pmc-12989452.creator: Abul B M Baki, Michele Mossa
pmc-12989452.description: Ecohydraulics sits at the dynamic intersection of fluid mechanics and ecological function. As the impacts of climate change, urbanization, and industrial expansion intensify, this emerging discipline offers powerful tools for restoring and managing rivers, lakes, and coastal zones through nature-based, science-driven solutions.

pmc-13390116.title: Psychiatric difficulties in females with fragile X syndrome: a systematic review and meta-analyses
pmc-13390116.creator: Lauren Jenner, Christina Koenig, Rachel M. Hantman, Abigail L. Hogan, Jane E. Roberts, Jessica Klusek
pmc-13390116.description: IntroductionFragile X syndrome (FXS) is the most common monogenic cause of autism, yet research has largely prioritized males. Females show more variable phenotypes and remain comparatively understudied. This paper provides the first systematic review and meta-analysis of psychiatric difficulties in females with FXS, examines associations with intellectual ability and co-occurring autism, and evaluates sex representation within the FXS psychiatric literature.

uslaw-usc-t30-s1514.title: 30 U.S.C. § 1514 — Program termination
uslaw-usc-t30-s1514.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s1514.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 27 (Geothermal Energy); Subchapter I (Project Loans). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No new loans shall be made under this subchapter after September 30, 1986. Amounts repaid on or before September 30, 1986, on loans theretofore made under section 1511 of this title shall be deposited in the Geothermal Resources Development Fund.
